questions.question: Which tags does tag(high) assign to the frontier deployment in main?
options: Only organizational_risks
No tags because the deployment is not public
malicious_use, ai_races, organizational_risks, and rogue_ais
Only rogue_ais
questions.explanation: The high deployment is public and handles harmful capabilities, faces competitive pressure, lacks all three organizational controls, and has 48 hours of autonomy.

questions.question: What conjunction is required for the malicious_use tag?
options: Competitive pressure and four hours of autonomy
A missing audit or missing information security
Public exposure alone
Both handles_harmful_capabilities and public_facing must be true
questions.explanation: tag appends malicious_use only when the deployment both handles harmful capabilities and is public-facing.

questions.question: When does tag add organizational_risks?
options: When any of independent_audit, multi_layer_defense, or information_security is false
Only when all three controls are false
Whenever the service has a public user
Only when autonomy is below one hour
questions.explanation: org_missing is an OR of the three absent safeguards, so one missing sub-lever is enough to add organizational_risks.

questions.question: What is the autonomy threshold for rogue_ais in the local inventory?
options: More than 48 hours only
At least 4.0 hours
Exactly 1.0 hour
Any nonzero autonomy
questions.explanation: The code appends rogue_ais when agent_autonomy_hours >= 4.0, so the mid deployment at exactly four hours qualifies.

questions.question: Why does the low internal refactor helper receive no tags?
options: It has no model at all
It is public and handles harmful capabilities
It is non-public, lacks harmful capability handling and competitive pressure, and has every listed organizational control
The tag function ignores internal deployments
questions.explanation: The low fixture has false public/harmful/competitive flags, true audit/defense/security controls, and one hour of autonomy, so none of the four conditions fires.

questions.question: Which risk set matches the mid public coding agent?
options: malicious_use only
No risks because it has an independent audit
All four risks
ai_races, organizational_risks, and rogue_ais, but not malicious_use
questions.explanation: The mid fixture is competitive, has information_security=False, and has four hours of autonomy; it does not handle harmful capabilities, so malicious_use is absent.
